scope: Source-backed protocol and API research for the three remediation issues; no dependency upgrades or pool-default changes.

evidence.finding: Legacy JSON iteration validates terminal status and raises on an interrupted stream. Parallel pages must reach the concrete iterator's EOF before acceptance.
Requests enables HTTP content decoding when streaming through urllib3. Sized raw reads must explicitly request decoding too.

HTTPResponse.read accepts decode_content, retains a decoded buffer across partial reads, and rejects switching back to undecoded reads. Python 3.14's compression.zstd supports the zstd decoder without an extra dependency.
The standard executor's bounded buffering counts submitted tasks until results are yielded. Closing its result iterator cancels queued futures.
Queued futures can be cancelled; executor shutdown waits for running threads. The remediation cancels pending work before the existing context manager waits.
The native pool is configured at process startup; POLARS_MAX_THREADS cannot resize an already initialized pool.
Python connection creation forwards config options to DuckDB. to_arrow_table is the current Arrow conversion API; fetch_arrow_table is deprecated.
